pages.text: Flying Sword, Sword Convergence, Sword Aura, and Sky-Splitting Sword Aura form the sword spell family. They benefit from sword bonuses, Metal affinity, Spell Power, and weapon modifiers.

Sky-Splitting Sword Aura fires a quick slash on click. Hold, charge, then release to send a huge slash. Its damage scales with charged qi, weapon bonuses, and Spell Power; extreme charge adds direct health loss.
